prompt.description: What to draw. For a transparent image, set transparent, or begin with "This is an RGBA image with transparency." and end with "The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent."

transparent.title: Transparent background
transparent.description: Transparent background (RGBA PNG): wraps the prompt in Qwen's transparency format. Each result's alpha says whether the PNG kept its alpha channel.

width.description: Image width in pixels, a multiple of 32; native up to 2K (2048 × 2048, 2752 × 1536).

height.description: Image height in pixels, a multiple of 32.
